Kya 13 hajar ekar jamin aur ek mega pul dashkon se jari palayan ko rok paega? kya uttar bihar ab barh aur pichhrepan ka dansh bhulkar udyogaptiyon ki naee pasand banega? endie sarkar ka ek sal pura hone par pradhanmantri narendr modi bihar ke vaishali men bari janasbha karne ja rahe hain. shanivar ko rajy ko tin lakh karor rupae ki dhaee hajar vikas yojnaon ki saugat denge. aaie, aasan binduon men samajhte hain ki piem ke is daure ka aarthik aur siyasi ganit kya hai.
